gloss: agreement; written agreement; memorandum of understanding

definitions.gloss: written agreement; memorandum of understanding; accord document
definitions.explanation: A formal written document recording the terms agreed upon by two or more parties. Less binding than a full contract but carries legal and moral weight.

examples.japanese: {合意書|ごういしょ}に{署名|しょめい}する。
{両者|りょうしゃ}の{間|あいだ}で{合意書|ごういしょ}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: Both parties exchanged a written agreement.

examples.japanese: {離婚|りこん}の{条件|じょうけん}について{合意書|ごういしょ}を{作成|さくせい}し、{弁護士|べんごし}に{確認|かくにん}してもらった。
examples.english: We drafted an agreement on the divorce conditions and had a lawyer review it.

notes:
A compound of {合意|ごうい} (agreement/consensus) + {書|しょ} (document). Used in legal, business, and personal contexts where parties need to formally record their agreement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合意書|ごういしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する: to draft an agreement
- {合意書|ごういしょ}に{署名|しょめい}する: to sign an agreement
- {合意書|ごういしょ}を{交|か}わす: to exchange agreements
- {合意書|ごういしょ}の{内容|ないよう}: contents of the agreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {契約書|けいやくしょ}: contract — a more formal and legally binding document
- {覚書|おぼえがき}: memorandum — a written record of understanding, similar in function
- {同意書|どういしょ}: consent form — a document expressing consent to something specific
- {誓約書|せいやくしょ}: written pledge — a document with a promise or oath
